column1: # Replay set for local-delegate acceptance (1831-74sf): already-landed size:S packets.
# Columns (tab separated): order  landed_sha  prefix_sha  overlay_files  owned_files  closure_command
#   prefix_sha = landed_sha^1: the pre-fix tree. overlay_files = test files taken from landed_sha and laid
#   over the pre-fix tree, so the closure command FAILS there; on landed_sha it PASSES. landed_sha is an
#   ancestor of origin/linux-next. Each row is proven both ways by verify-set.sh in this directory.
# The packet asked for 20 rows. Only 17 survive the both-ends proof: of the 103 size:S fragments, only some name a
# scripts/test-*.sh closure that a landing touched, and most of those pass vacuously on the pre-fix tree (they skip
# without a freshly built plan binary) or need a cargo build. The shortfall is recorded, not padded.
